ground.purpose: Page, sidebar, tables and the rules ledger.

surface.purpose: Cards, sheets, gate and panels; one step darker than the ground, always with a 1px border.

raised.purpose: Selected rule row, fold rows, secondary hover, disabled and locked buttons, skeletons.

raised-2.purpose: Filled-neutral pill, runway track, timeline grid, not-applicable span fill.

control.purpose: Secondary outline, hover outline, outlined-pill edge, text-selection ground.

text.purpose: Body text, figures, the only text on -hl tints; also focus and selection lines.

muted.purpose: Background prose, cells, sublines of rank two.

faint.purpose: Labels, IDs, captions, table headers; never on anything lighter than #2A2A2E.

primary.purpose: The one inverted-ink primary button per screen.

primary-hover.purpose: Primary hover fill (never a text colour).

verified.purpose: Verified against fetched text only: tick-and-tie, brand mark, gate pass pill, letter quote rule and underline, timeline bars.

verified-tint.purpose: Ground of the gate pass pill.

positive.purpose: Ledger Green hue: glyphs and chart lines.

positive-ink.purpose: Ledger Green words: pill labels, answer word, gutter status words.

positive-hl.purpose: Evidence span fill on the selected rule only; text on it is always --text.

warning.purpose: Docket Amber hue: glyphs and chart lines.

warning-ink.purpose: Docket Amber words: pill labels, answer word, gutter status words.

warning-hl.purpose: Evidence span fill on the selected rule only; text on it is always --text.

negative.purpose: Red glyphs, chart lines, the VOID edge and strike, the late tick.

negative-ink.purpose: Denial Red words: pill labels, answer word, gutter status words.

negative-hl.purpose: Evidence span fill on the selected rule only; text on it is always --text.

answer.purpose: The coloured case and check answer word with its 24px glyph; a paragraph, not the h1. 24/32 on phone.

figure.purpose: Deadline and earliest-date figures. 24/32 on phone.

title.purpose: Case h1 (breadcrumb current item), card and sheet titles, gate title, letter h3.

reading.purpose: Policy sentences, chart notes, the letter; 72ch measure.

label.purpose: Buttons, tabs, form labels, rule summaries, patient names.

caption.purpose: Sublines, table headers, context and meta lines, coverage labels.

micro.purpose: Pills, gutter IDs and status words, timeline labels, legal footer; VOID at 600. The floor.

id.purpose: Sentence addresses, policy IDs, claim codes, case/chart/note IDs only; inherits its line size.

extensions.elevation: Flat: tone step plus 1px border; no shadows anywhere.

motion.name: t
motion.purpose: Colour, background, outline and text-decoration-colour transitions; the chevron rotation.

motion.name: chevron
motion.purpose: Disclosure open state; the only animated transform.

motion.name: reduced
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> transition/animation none, scroll-behavior auto

focus.note: --focus and --select are ink (--text); text selection is ink on --control.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.note: Sidebar becomes a 48px top bar; grids to one column.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.note: Bottom bar, 16px gutters, tables become items.

glyphs.grid: 24px, fill none, round caps/joins; stroke 2 at 12-16px, 2.25 at 24px, 1.5 nav

avoid: The only text on any `-hl` tint is `--text`.
`--faint` never goes on anything lighter than #2A2A2E.
#8A8C92 and #FFF are never used for text.
No hue doubles as focus, selection or text selection.
lint.gate: inspect.mjs --app 0 FAIL / 0 WARN on nine screens; lint.mjs --app 0 FAIL, warnings for mono IDs and missing-value dashes only (reported at handoff).

narrative.northStar: Blue pencil on the claims desk
narrative.overview:
A claims desk read in eight-hour sessions. The ground is neutral graphite, text is a soft ink rather than white, and two greys sit far apart so prose, sublines and labels separate without colour. Colour appears only where a rule has decided something: a status hue on its own dark tint, always paired with a glyph and a word. One more hue, the blue pencil, is the auditor's non-photo-blue tick: it appears on every line the code has checked against text fetched for this case, and nowhere else.

The system is a taste-skill-v2 data-terminal app style (seed 1818343043), redrawn for legibility: a labelled sidebar instead of an icon rail, 14/20 body instead of 13, a 1px border on cards instead of a shadow, and ink (not the hue) for selection and focus. Density is a working tool's density: 60px table rows, ruled groups rather than boxes, one primary action per screen in inverted ink.

It refuses the generated dashboard: no KPI tiles, saturated chips, neon on black, hero headers or large status-tint areas. Motion is feedback only.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground, cards one tone step darker, every line 1px.
One hue, one meaning: blue pencil means "verified against fetched text".
Status is hue + glyph + word, on its own dark tint; never colour alone.
Public Sans for every word and figure; IBM Plex Mono for IDs only, at the size of its line.
Six type sizes, weights 400/500/600, sentence case, no tracked capitals.
Full-round controls and pills, 6px cards, one inverted-ink primary.

rules.name: The One Hue, One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Blue Pencil means "checked by code against text fetched for this case" and nothing else. It never marks selection, focus, buttons, tabs, nav, headings, links or the text-selection highlight. Selection lines and focus rings are ink; text selection is ink on Control grey (#3A3A3E).

rules.name: The Hue Plus Glyph Plus Word Rule
rules.body: A status is never a colour alone. Every pill, answer word, gutter status word and coverage stage carries its glyph and its word. The five verdicts differ by glyph, and the two neutrals differ by filled versus outlined.

rules.name: The Colour Only Where A Rule Decides Rule
rules.body: Colour sits only on the answer word and its glyph, pills, coverage glyphs and the holding stage's pill, gutter status words, evidence spans, the VOID block, chart marks, timeline bars, due-soon and overdue figures, the brand mark and verified ticks. Never on the ground, sidebar, nav, tabs, headings, buttons, links, borders, filters or table headers. Strongly coloured pixels stay under 3% of any first screen.

rules.name: The One Red Per Object Rule
rules.body: On a worklist row whose pill is red, the due figure stays ink. Due-soon and overdue colour applies only to actionable verdicts (Appeal, Ask the physician, Fix & resubmit); Not winnable figures are always Muted.

rules.name: The Six Sizes Rule
rules.body: 28, 24, 16, 14, 13 and 12px, at weights 400, 500 and 600. Nothing at 700 or above, nothing under 12px.

rules.name: The Mono Is For IDs Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono sets sentence addresses (S47), policy IDs (L34220 v40, CPB 0236), claim codes (CPT 72148, CARC 50) and case, chart and note IDs, always at `font-size: inherit` with tracking 0, so it takes the size of its line. Dates, days, money, citations, captions and prose are never mono. Mono stays under 15% of text.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Sentence case and zero tracking everywhere, apart from the two negative values above. VOID is the only uppercase word.

rules.name: The Border Or Nothing Rule
rules.body: A card gets a 1px border, never a shadow, and never both.

dos: **Do** put the Blue Pencil (#8EC5E8) tick-and-tie on every quote the code has verified against fetched text, and only there.
**Do** pair every status hue with its glyph and its word, on its own dark tint.
**Do** keep text on any `-hl` tint in `--text`, and fill a rule's spans only while that rule is selected.
**Do** keep exactly one inverted-ink primary per screen; locked actions use `aria-disabled` with the reason beside them.
**Do** set IDs in IBM Plex Mono at the inherited size, and everything else, figures included, in Public Sans with tabular numerals.
**Do** separate surfaces with a tone step and a 1px line; draw hover as a 1px Control outline.
**Do** keep motion at 120ms on `cubic-bezier(.2, 0, 0, 1)`, and off under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use the blue for selection, focus, buttons, tabs, nav, headings, links or the text-selection highlight.
**Don't** put `--negative` text on anything but `--ground`, `--surface` or `--negative-tint`, or `--faint` on anything lighter than #2A2A2E.
**Don't** add shadows, left accent bars, large status-tint areas, KPI tiles, saturated chips or hero headers.
**Don't** colour headings, the h1, buttons, links, borders, nav, filters or table headers.
**Don't** use a sixth size outside 28/24/16/14/13/12, a weight above 600, tracked capitals or text under 12px.
**Don't** set dates, days, money, captions or prose in mono.
**Don't** animate position, scale or entrance; the chevron rotation is the only moving transform.
